questions.prompt: What is the difference between a constrained array type `type Vec3 is array (1 .. 3) of Float;` and an unconstrained array type `type Vec is array (Positive range <>) of Float;`?

options.text: Unconstrained arrays leave index bounds open (`<>`) so each object or parameter can supply its own bounds
Constrained arrays cannot be passed to functions

code.source:
type Vec is array (Positive range <>) of Float;
V : Vec (1 .. 5) := (others => 0.0);

questions.prompt: When writing a loop over an unconstrained array parameter `A : Vec`, why is `for I in A'Range loop` preferred over `1 .. A'Length`?

options.text: Slices or arrays passed to `A` may have a lower bound other than `1` (e.g., `A (5 .. 10)`), so `A'Range` avoids `Constraint_Error`

questions.prompt: Match each Ada array attribute to what it returns for `A : array (2 .. 5) of Integer;`.
What does the aggregate `(1 => 10, 3 => 30, others => 0)` produce for an array of `1 .. 4`?
What does sliding assignment `A (1 .. 3) := B (4 .. 6);` do in Ada?

options.text: Copies the 3 elements from `B (4 .. 6)` into `A (1 .. 3)` as long as lengths match

questions.prompt: Select all valid statements about Ada `record` types. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Record equality `=` compares all components recursively by default
Fields can have default values (e.g. `Count : Natural := 0;`)
Records can be initialized with positional or named aggregates (`(X => 1.0, Y => 2.0)`)

questions.prompt: What is a discriminated record (variant record) in Ada?

options.text: A record with private fields only
A C union without type safety
A record parameterized by a discriminant (like `Kind : Shape_Kind`) that can control array sizes or `case Kind is` variant fields
A record that cannot be copied

questions.prompt: What does `limited private` mean for a type declared in a package specification?

options.text: The type can only hold integers
Clients cannot see its representation AND cannot copy (`:=`) or compare (`=`) values of that type outside the package

questions.prompt: Match each Ada subprogram parameter mode to its semantics.

columns.label: Read-only input; cannot be modified inside the subprogram
Write-only output; caller's variable is updated with the result
Readable and writable; initial value is passed in and final value is returned

questions.prompt: In Ada, if a formal parameter is a large `record` or `array` with mode `in`, does the compiler copy the entire struct on every call?

options.text: No—composite types may be passed by reference by the compiler (and `tagged` / `limited` types are always passed by reference)

questions.prompt: What is the difference between a normal `access T` type and `access all T` (general access type) in Ada?

options.text: `access T` can only point to heap objects created by `new T`; `access all T` can also point to stack/static `aliased` objects via `'Access`

code.source:
X : aliased Integer := 10;
P : access all Integer := X'Access;

questions.prompt: Why is `not null access T` useful in Ada 2005+?

options.text: It guarantees at compile time / initialization that the access value is never `null`, eliminating null-dereference checks inside the callee

questions.prompt: How do you safely deallocate a heap object allocated with `new T` when you have `type T_Ptr is access T;`?
What does `procedure Swap (A, B : in out Integer);` vs a generic `generic type T is private; procedure Swap (A, B : in out T);` demonstrate?

options.text: Compile-time generic parameterization: the generic must be instantiated (`procedure Swap_Int is new Swap (Integer);`) before calling

questions.prompt: Select all valid generic formal parameters in an Ada `generic` specification. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `type T is limited private;` (no `:=` or `=` assumed)
`with function Compare (L, R : T) return Boolean;` (formal subprogram)
`type T is (<>);` (any discrete type: integer or enumeration)

questions.prompt: What is a child package `package Math.Vectors is ...` in Ada?

options.text: A separate compilation unit that is part of the `Math` hierarchy and can access `Math`'s `private` part

questions.prompt: Select all valid ways to reference declarations from another package `My_Pkg` in Ada. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `use My_Pkg;` to make all public declarations directly visible
`use type My_Pkg.Vector;` to make only operators of `Vector` directly visible

questions.prompt: What does `function F (X : Integer) return Integer renames Math.Fast_F;` do?

options.text: Copies the machine code at runtime

questions.prompt: How do you raise and catch an exception in Ada?
What does `Ada.Exceptions.Exception_Information (E)` provide inside `when E : others =>`?

options.text: Exception name, message, and source/traceback info (when compiled with traceback support)

questions.prompt: What does `raise;` (with no exception name) inside an `exception` handler do?

options.text: Re-raises the exact current exception occurrence (preserving its message and traceback)

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of `pragma Elaborate_All (Pkg);` or `Elaborate_Body` in Ada?

options.text: To control package elaboration order before the main subprogram runs, preventing `Program_Error` (access-before-elaboration)

questions.prompt: Match each Ada I/O package to its use case.

columns.label: Homogeneous typed binary records read/written sequentially

questions.prompt: In `Ada.Text_IO`, what does `End_Of_File (File)` return?

options.text: `True` when no more lines/characters remain to be read from `File`

questions.prompt: What is the difference between `subtype` and `type` when overloading subprograms?

options.text: Subtypes share the same base type, so two subprograms differing only by subtypes of the same type are ambiguous/illegal; derived types are distinct
Overloading is not allowed in Ada

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about Ada expressions and `others` in aggregates. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `others` can be used in the middle of an aggregate
`others` must appear last in an aggregate
`(others => 0)` can initialize an entire array whose bounds are known from context
Record aggregates must account for every component (explicitly or via `others`)

questions.prompt: What does `Val'Old` in a postcondition or `T'Size` vs `T'Object_Size` represent? Specifically, what does `Arr'Component_Size` return?

options.text: Size in bits of a single element of `Arr`

questions.prompt: What does `X'Valid` return for a scalar variable `X`?

options.text: `True` if `X` holds a valid representation within its subtype's range (useful after unchecked I/O or C interop)

questions.prompt: What is `Ada.Command_Line` used for?
Select all true statements about `Ada.Strings.Unbounded` vs fixed `String`. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Fixed `String` requires bounds to be fixed at object initialization

questions.prompt: What does `for E of Arr loop` (Ada 2012) provide compared to `for I in Arr'Range loop`?

options.text: `E` directly aliases each element of `Arr` (and can even modify elements if `Arr` is a variable)

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of `private` in a package specification (`package P is ... private ... end P;`)?

options.text: It hides implementation details (like record fields of a `private` type) from clients while still allowing the compiler to know the type's size
It runs code only in debug mode

questions.prompt: What does `return R : My_Limited_Type do ... end return;` (extended return statement, Ada 2005+) enable?

options.text: Constructing and initializing a `limited` object directly in the caller's target location without copying

questions.prompt: Select all valid ways to handle a missing or invalid file in `Ada.Text_IO.Open`. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Catch `Ada.Text_IO.Use_Error` if permissions or device constraints prevent opening
Catch `Ada.Text_IO.Name_Error` if the file does not exist

questions.prompt: What does `Ada.Numerics.Elementary_Functions` provide?
What is `Ada.Numerics.Discrete_Random`?

options.text: A generic package instantiated with a discrete type/subtype to generate uniform pseudo-random values

questions.prompt: How do you declare a custom operator like `"+"` for a `Vector2D` record in Ada?

options.text: Operators cannot be overloaded in Ada

function "+" (A, B : Vec2) return Vec2 is
  ((A.X + B.X, A.Y + B.Y));

Suppress the unused-variable/parameter compiler warning intentionally (e.g., in callback signatures)
